flags: Brookfield Infrastructure announced that it received all required approvals to complete its corporate structure simplification combining BIP and Brookfield Infrastructure Corporation into Brookfield Infrastructure Partners Inc., expected to close on November 19, 2026 with securityholders receiving Class A Shares on a one-for-one basis.

Brookfield Infrastructure announced that it is not declaring a fourth quarter of 2026 distribution or dividend prior to closing of the Simplification, and that following closing BIP Inc. intends to declare and pay a fourth quarter dividend consistent with BIP’s current quarterly distribution of US$0.455 per unit.

BIP’s distribution reinvestment plan was terminated effective November 5, 2026 in connection with the Simplification, with the final distribution of BIP units under the plan made for the distribution paid on September 29, 2026.

If our operations in these jurisdictions require significant capital expenditures to maintain our asset base, we may not be able to recover such costs through the regulatory framework.

To the extent such regimes (such as carbon emissions schemes or other carbon emissions regulations) become applicable to the operations of Brookfield Infrastructure (and the costs of such regulations are not able to be fully passed on to consumers), our financial performance may be impacted due to costs applied to carbon emissions and increased compliance costs.
